download.title: Open the file’s menu
download.text: Find MedicareCorsair.exe. Click the three dots beside it.

download.title: Choose Keep
download.text: Choose Keep only for this file from our GitHub release.
download.label: Keep

download.title: Expand the warning
download.text: Click Show more. In some versions, click the small arrow beside Delete instead.
download.label: Show more  ▾

download.title: Choose Keep anyway
download.text: If the warning is about an unfamiliar file and you trust this download, choose Keep anyway. Stop if it reports malware.
download.label: Keep anyway

install.title: Turn on Developer mode
install.text: On the Extensions page, look near the bottom of the left sidebar. Click the switch beside Developer mode so it turns on.
install.label: Developer mode

install.title: Click Load unpacked
install.text: Look at the top of the Extensions page. Click Load unpacked.
install.label: Load unpacked

downloadCards.title: 1. Three dots → Keep
downloadCards.text: In Downloads (Ctrl+J), find MedicareCorsair.exe. Click its ⋯ menu, then Keep.

downloadCards.title: 2. Show more → Keep anyway
downloadCards.text: Expand Show more (or the arrow beside Delete), then Keep anyway.

downloadCards.title: 3. Open file → More info → Run anyway
downloadCards.text: Open MedicareCorsair.exe. If Windows shows a reputation warning, click More info, then Run anyway.

download.title: Review the download
download.text: Find MedicareCorsair.exe and click its warning or menu. If it is marked unfamiliar and you trust this GitHub download, choose the option to keep it. Stop if it reports malware.
download.label: MedicareCorsair.exe  ⋯

download.title: Open the app
download.text: Once the download finishes, click MedicareCorsair.exe.
download.label: MedicareCorsair.exe

install.title: Turn on Developer mode
install.text: On the Extensions page, look in the top-right corner. Click the switch beside Developer mode so it turns on.
install.label: Developer mode

install.title: Click Load unpacked
install.text: A row of buttons appears near the top-left. Click Load unpacked.
install.label: Load unpacked

downloadCards.title: 1. Click the arrow beside the file
downloadCards.text: Open Downloads (Ctrl+J). Click the arrow beside MedicareCorsair.exe if it was blocked as unfamiliar.

downloadCards.title: 2. Review the warning
downloadCards.text: For an unfamiliar file you trust, choose Download suspicious file or Download unverified file, matching your warning. Do not turn off Safe Browsing.

downloadCards.title: 3. Open file → More info → Run anyway
downloadCards.text: Open MedicareCorsair.exe. If Windows shows a reputation warning, click More info, then Run anyway.

download.title: Open Downloads
download.text: Click the download arrow in the Firefox toolbar.
download.label: Downloads ↓

download.title: Review and open the file
download.text: Find MedicareCorsair.exe. Review any warning and open only if you trust this GitHub download. Stop if it reports malware.
download.label: MedicareCorsair.exe

install.title: Choose This Firefox
install.text: On the debugging page, click This Firefox in the left sidebar if it is not already selected.
install.label: This Firefox

install.title: Load the add-on
install.text: Click Load Temporary Add-on near the top of the page.
install.label: Load Temporary Add-on

downloadCards.title: 1. Open Downloads
downloadCards.text: Click the download arrow. For an unfamiliar-file warning, click the arrow beside MedicareCorsair.exe to review it.

downloadCards.title: 2. Review before opening
downloadCards.text: Only for an unfamiliar file you trust, choose Allow Download or Open. Mozilla’s example is an older Firefox layout.

downloadCards.title: 3. Open file → More info → Run anyway
downloadCards.text: If Windows shows a reputation warning, click More info, then Run anyway. Temporary Firefox extensions are removed when Firefox closes.

macCards.title: 1. Open the ZIP, then the app
macCards.text: Open MedicareCorsair-macOS.zip (or the Intel version). Open MedicareCorsair.app. This unsigned app may be blocked.

macCards.title: 2. Review macOS permission
macCards.text: If you trust this GitHub download: Apple menu → System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Confirm Open.

macCards.title: 3. Choose your browser in the app
macCards.text: Use Chrome, Edge, or Firefox. The helper shows its matching extension screenshot. Safari is not supported.
